entities.summary: Francisco Pinto da Cunha Leal was a Portuguese politician during the period of the Portuguese First Republic. He served as 84th Prime Minister of Portugal between 1921 and 1922. He was the leader and founder of the União Liberal Republicana (ULR) party.
